text: Several visitors reported problems with the location information, noting that incorrect map pins and directions led them to remote farmland instead of the library. The timed-entry ticketing system caused frustration for some, especially those who arrived without reservations or needed to change tickets, with reports of poor customer service and lack of assistance. While interactive exhibits received attention, there were mixed feelings about the AI features. Some visitors also mentioned issues with food quality and limited flexibility at the entrance. Staff were generally described as kind, but overall accessibility and visitor communication need improvement.

windows.7: Several visitors reported significant problems with finding the library, citing incorrect or misleading location pins on Google Maps that directed them to farmland or distant areas rather than the actual site. The timed entry system also caused frustration, with at least one visitor turned away for not having a reservation despite low visitor numbers and no apparent flexibility. Some users found the AI assistant unhelpful when seeking customer support, and a few criticized the quality of food available on-site. Positive comments were made about the interactive exhibits and staff kindness, but wayfinding and customer service need attention.
